notes.title: 1.0.5 playtest hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixed the issue where the boss disappears. 
 Fixed the issue where the game becomes unplayable when receiving random abilities from the vending machine.

notes.title: Suit preview function patch
notes.notes: There was a problem with the suit preview function, so I patched it. After the update, if you operate the preview function, it may crash. Please uninstall the entire game and reinstall it. Sorry.
